# GEOFlow gate deploy — paste in order on VPS
# Expect: OK_* then DONE_GEOFLOW_GATE

echo '' | sudo tee /tmp/geoflow-agent.b64 >/dev/null && echo OK_AGENT_1
echo '' | sudo tee -a /tmp/geoflow-agent.b64 >/dev/null && echo OK_AGENT_2
base64 -d /tmp/geoflow-agent.b64 | gunzip | sudo tee /opt/ai-relay/static/brand/blog/geoflow-agent/index.php >/dev/null && echo OK_WRITE_AGENT

echo '' | sudo tee /tmp/geoflow-rebuild.b64 >/dev/null && echo OK_REBUILD_1
